title: Suryoday Small Finance Bank fixes record date for final dividend just now Suryoday Small Finance Bank has announced July 17, 2026, as the record date for the final dividend recommended in May, contingent on shareholder approval at the AGM on August 06, 2026. Additionally, the meeting sanctioned the re-appointment of Director Mr. Ranjit Jayant Shah and modifications to the ESOP scheme
